note: Rejudged 2026-10-21 over the current tags, units and records. Product fix verified against the RFCs. RFC 7684 Section 2.1: route types 'correspond directly to the OSPFv2 LSAs types'. RFC 5250 Section 3: type-11 LSAs are 'not flooded into stub areas or Not-So-Stubby Areas (NSSAs)'. So an NSSA-external prefix needs area scope, and extPrefixScope now returns AS scope for AS-external only. TestExtPrefixScopeSelection asserts all four mappings (NSSA-external is area, AS-external is AS). The per-LSA pair proves real originated LSAs never mix scopes. Observation: ext_prefix.go originates only intra-area, inter-area and AS-external prefixes, so no origination path reaches the NSSA-external branch yet. The row's trailing note describes the function, not an originated case.
